title: The High-Volume Return Premium
one_line: Stocks with unusually high trading volume over a day or week tend to rise over the following month (visibility raises demand); unusually low volume predicts lower returns.

findings.statement: High-volume winners and losers both outperform over the next month.

reported_results.headline: Stocks with unusually high trading volume over a day or week tend to rise over the following month (visibility raises demand); unusually low volume predicts lower returns.
